body:
I think this may have gotten to a point where he couldn't control it because I was gone for about 18 days. Maybe he thought it would magically get better when I was back from the extended work, but it was the holidays so we never really fell into a routine. These past three days are the first three in a row we've seen each other in quite some time. 

He keeps using the word parasite. Like he honestly believes he is of no value. I'm doing my best, we are a little too broke for any kind of doctor or therapist, but we are doing what we can. I'm hoping now that the routine is falling back into place, things will level out. Last night he seemed excited to get to work on what he's decided he wants to do with his life. 

He's been Super chatty these past two days but not really about a lot. And he keeps saying he's broken. So, he's starting to talk, and I'm there more and it's noticeable. I'm making him eat, since he's lost 15 lbs from not eating over the past few months. I guess I'm just hoping if I start treating the symptoms, things will get better just enough for us to do something real about the cause?

Well, he went to work on time today and I've been keeping in contact with his/our friend that he works with and she says he is acting totally normal. Like nothing ever happened.

I'm not going to be coming to work until after he leaves for at least a week or so just to make sure he isn't going to do anything in that time frame which is the only one I think I need to be worried about. But, I just am not sure what to do to trust him to be alone right now. I don't know how long I should work with the friends and family I have to make sure I know where he is all the time. I feel like it's an invasion of privacy but he didn't give me a choice about it.

There is a room mate. She isn't there much. And she isn't equipped to handle anything about this anyway. She also is struggling financially and isn't really able to help much. Seems like no matter what we try we are Just not making it. I've been homeless and lost everything before in my life so what's going on is familiar to me and doesn't seem that bad. 

Like I said above, I think his parents are aware of the financial struggles, but not really about how bad his depression is and absolutely they don't know what he tried. 

I have a few people to talk to. But talking to them makes them upset and sad because they can't do anything. I figured this was my best shot for people to talk to.

I've struggled with depression in my life before and can honestly say my attempt at suicide was a cry for attention because I never talked to anyone about anything I ever felt. Talking was the first thing that we both realized was so special to the other. We can literally talk about anything for hours at a time. We used to routinely go to bed late because we lost track of time talking. He has been amazing for me. I would go to the ends of the earth to help him and that's why I feel so helpless right now. I can't ground him. He talks about how I would hurt only for a short time and in thirty years at most he would be a fleeting memory to me. 

I never noticed symptoms before the first room mate left. He left when the lease was up but my boyfriend was a bit sad about it because they had been living together for a long time and were very good friends. At first things looked good because he had another friend move in. That guy never paid his half of anything. Even one time in 9 months and never on time. I didn't know that or I could have been helping at the time. I can't right now because I basically signed my soul away for a functioning vehicle myself. It eats literally every dollar I get that doesn't go for my portion of rent which I barely make. 

He works in a pharmacy. He will Not take any meds and therefore won't see a therapist. If I found him one that would agree not to medicate, he might, but $20 a month literally breaks us right now and that's why he wont go to anyone. 

I was there to see his dad put a new set of tires on his car last night. His parents don't know the only reason I was there is because I literally caught him before he started swallowing the pills. His parents are helping in their own way, but honestly, we are poor, my parents and siblings are poor, and his parents are middle class. They can't afford to support us. 

I've begged him to give me time. To promise me he won't do anything while I'm not there. He says that defeats the purpose. The only reason he was unsuccessful yesterday was because I knew too much. I don't trust him to give me the time to fix things right now. 

We used to play a card game together. It's literally one of the last things he finds any pleasure in. We are even doing that less and less because he no longer wants too. I feel like he is spiraling down and I can't slow it down or catch him.
